mapper.select: SELECT cfg.ds_id AS dsId, cfg.space_name AS spaceName, adm.manage_state AS manageState FROM t_ds_config cfg INNER JOIN t_ds_config_admin adm ON adm.ds_id = cfg.ds_id AND adm.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cfg.is_deleted = 0 AND cfg.space_name IS NOT NULL AND cfg.space_name != '' AND adm.manage_state != 'DELETED'
